nixpkgs.expr: let path = builtins.getEnv "NH_FLAKE"; flake = builtins.getFlake (if path != "" then path else builtins.getEnv "HOME" + "/work/nunix"); name = builtins.getEnv "NIXOS_HOST"; host = if name != "" then name else builtins.replaceStrings [ "\n" ] [ "" ] (builtins.readFile /etc/hostname); in flake.nixosConfigurations.${host}.pkgs

nixos.expr: let path = builtins.getEnv "NH_FLAKE"; flake = builtins.getFlake (if path != "" then path else builtins.getEnv "HOME" + "/work/nunix"); name = builtins.getEnv "NIXOS_HOST"; host = if name != "" then name else builtins.replaceStrings [ "\n" ] [ "" ] (builtins.readFile /etc/hostname); in flake.nixosConfigurations.${host}.options

home-manager.expr: let path = builtins.getEnv "NH_FLAKE"; flake = builtins.getFlake (if path != "" then path else builtins.getEnv "HOME" + "/work/nunix"); name = builtins.getEnv "NIXOS_HOST"; host = if name != "" then name else builtins.replaceStrings [ "\n" ] [ "" ] (builtins.readFile /etc/hostname); in flake.nixosConfigurations.${host}.options.home-manager.users.type.getSubOptions []
